claim: Repo source of truth beats review projections: margin/PR-comments/Cursor-handoff-docs/chat-summaries are review surfaces, not sources of truth. Workflow: update the repo file first → publish the rendered review copy second → fold review comments back into the repo file → reuse the same Margin doc when revising → never treat Margin comments as approval.

decisions.notes: Recorded 2026-07-04 planning session. Establishes precedence of committed artifact over any review surface.
